title: Botox & Jeuveau
text:
Smooth. Refresh. Prevent.
Neurotoxin injections are one of the most effective treatments for softening fine lines and reducing dynamic wrinkles.


These FDA-approved treatments temporarily relax facial muscles—reducing frown lines, crow’s feet, and forehead creases—while keeping your natural expressions.




Botox – The classic wrinkle treatment
Jeuveau – A modern alternative with similar results





Consultation: We’ll review your goals and medical history, and design a plan tailored to your facial anatomy.
Treatment: Quick 15-minute injections with minimal discomfort. Numbing available if needed.
Aftercare: Avoid exercise and alcohol for 24 hours. Stay upright for 4 hours.
Results: Visible in 2–14 days. Follow-up visits included for adjustments.




Most results last 3–4 months, with some medical applications (e.g., hyperhidrosis) lasting up to a year.

title: Facial Balancing
text:
Harmonize your features and rejuvenate your look with a customized dermal filler approach.


Strategic filler placement in multiple areas—like cheeks, jawline, chin, and under-eyes—to enhance symmetry, support structure, and refresh contours.




Thorough consultation with Sarah Rizvi, PA
Facial assessment to identify key treatment areas
Personalized plan—never one-size-fits-all





Numbing as needed
45–60 minute session
Mild swelling or redness resolves in a few days





Avoid alcohol, NSAIDs, and vitamins 48h prior
No dental work or vaccines ±2 weeks
Post-care: Ice, rest, avoid heat & manipulation





9 to 18 months depending on product and area

title: SkinPen Microneedling
text:
Reveal radiant, smoother, firmer skin—naturally.



FDA-cleared microneedling device
Triggers collagen & elastin production
Improves texture, acne scars, and fine lines





Skin is cleansed and numbed
30-minute procedure using SkinPen
Feels like buzzing or light pricking





0–72h: Redness like a mild sunburn
Days 2–3: Light flaking as skin renews
Day 4+: Resume normal skincare. Notice brighter tone and refined texture





Some visible after 1 session
Best: 3 sessions spaced 4 weeks apart




Now offering Ariessence PDGF (Platelet-Derived Growth Factor) post-treatment enhancement. This cutting-edge, pharmaceutical-grade topical serum contains recombinant PDGF-BB to accelerate skin healing, boost collagen, and improve tone and texture.
Ariessence PDGF delivers concentrated growth factors to stimulate natural skin regeneration, enhancing results and reducing downtime for a healthier, more youthful appearance. It offers a pure, consistent alternative to blood-derived PRP.
Prices vary depending on package purchase and will be discussed during consultation.

title: The Perfect Derma Peel
text:
Brighten, resurface, and reveal radiant skin with minimal downtime.


A medical-grade, medium-depth chemical peel to improve:

Hyperpigmentation
Acne scars
Melasma
Fine lines & dullness





TCA, Retinoic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Kojic Acid
Glutathione: powerful antioxidant that brightens skin





15–20 minute appointment
You leave with the peel on
Peeling starts around Day 3 and may last ~7 days





Post-peel kit included (towelettes, moisturizer, SPF)
Avoid workouts, makeup, and sun until peeling stops
Do not pick flaking skin





Brighter, smoother skin in ~2 weeks
